notes.title: Down to Hell left Early Access!
notes.content:
Down to Hell - full version
We're handing over the full version of Down to Hell with two chapters of the story.

During the early access phase, we made some important changes, thanks to comments volunteer testers, as well as the observations reported at PGA and our forum.

We've added a few new sceneries that give you the right feeling. We have rebuilt the first chapter - it is more varied and there is more places to visit and items to collect.

The most important change is to focus on fighting, not on hero upgrades.

On the way, there are common monsters waiting for you, but the main element of the game remains the Bosses.

[h1][b]Chapter One:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Crimson - jumping worm known to many alpha-testing players
[*] Obscura - a boss with two faces, angry, violent and aggressive.
[*] Wolf - just a big wolf. With three heads.
[*] Oteph - the final boss of the first chapter. Seemingly slow, but difficult to defeat the demon.
[*] 
[/list]
[h1][b]Chapter Two:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Schuldiner - Heavy armored. Difficult one.
[*] Agalloch - Little flying mage. With powerful spells.
[*] Solitude - a lady from hell.
[*] Vector - the final boss of chapter two. He carries two blades. He can surprise you.
[/list]

Good luck, and... don't surrender too fast.
[i]
Best,
~Red Dev Studio[/i]

notes.title: Devblog #2
notes.content:
[h1]The Early Access date is getting closer but we are working hard to give you the best game possible...[/h1]

[b]Intro[/b]
We are working on the intro to the game. As you can see it's only a sketch cause we don't want to show you too much before playing ;). But of course, you can get a glimpse of what will be in the opening of Down to Hell.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33761589/6567bcdea7e937d78330f03993421072132ca7f2.png[/img]

[b]Music[/b]
We are working hard to give you the best soundtrack possible in the next couple of days we will reveal another band that agreed to take part in Down to Hell.

[b]Bosses[/b]
Crimson already awaits for new opponents. As we mentioned he will be the first mini-boss in Down to Hell. He is fairly easy but be prepared cause he can annihilate you with one combo.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33761589/6516a50bd73ca847cabfff5550d5e02c25d8effe.gif[/img]

[b]Discord and Facebook[/b]
If you want to ask us a question feel free to do it on our:
Discord channel [url=https://discord.gg/VS7aBMx]https://discord.gg/VS7aBMx[/url]
Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/reddevstudio/]https://www.facebook.com/reddevstudio/[/url]

notes.title: Devblog #1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33761589/9197b70ebf6dd7f9e2831ddf23c93caf54ae7477.gif[/img]
[h1]So it’s time for our first DevBlog, here we will be posting stuff about the progress that we are making with [b]Down to Hell[/b]. So buckle up and let’s go…[/h1]

[b]Early Access[/b]
Fist and foremost we would like to tell you the exact date of the Early Access start, so…

[b]Down to Hell[/b] will be available to play on [b]November 30th[/b]. Remember that in the EA some things could not work properly. But we want each of you to have actual influence on the game. That’s why we started our own discord channel where you can talk with us and share your comments about [b]Down to Hell[/b]. You can join our [b]discord[/b] here right now [url=https://discord.gg/VS7aBMx]https://discord.gg/VS7aBMx[/url]. 

[b]Bosses
[/b]We are giving final tweaks for the bosses in the first level. You already know Crimson, right? As we said on PGA he is the easiest one so better be prepared for Obscura and Oteph! They will be waiting for you on [b]November 30th[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33761589/1a60edd308030084cf83b35c2f8ae4f811f370d3.gif[/img]

[b]Music[/b]
As we are saying everywhere we will have Heavy F’N Metal soundtrack. The first band that will be in the game is [b]KORONAL[/b]. Check out one of their tracks here →  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vWqAD2o_68k]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vWqAD2o_68k[/url]

But that’s not everything! Are you in a metal band or know someone that is? Just give us a call on discord or facebook (links below) we will gladly talk about cooperation!

Soon we will announce another band so stay tuned!

[b]Animations[/b]
You could’ve seen on the trailer that animations are a little bit stiff. We want you to know that we’ve been working hard to make them more fluid. The trailer will be updated but now we are focusing on making the best game we can.

[b]Discord and Facebook[/b]
Once again if you want to ask us a question feel free to do it on our:
Discord channel [url=https://discord.gg/VS7aBMx]https://discord.gg/VS7aBMx[/url]
Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/reddevstudio/]https://www.facebook.com/reddevstudio/[/url]

[b]Raise your horns brothers and sisters and see you soon![/b]
